cards.name: Crocodile Crawl
cards.kidInstruction: Lie low on your belly and crawl forward, staying flat like a crocodile sliding through water.

cards.name: Crab Walk
cards.kidInstruction: Sit down, put your hands behind you, lift your bottom up, and walk sideways like a crab.

cards.name: Bear Walk
cards.kidInstruction: Hands and feet on the ground, bottom in the air. Walk forward like a big strong bear.

cards.name: Lion Pose
cards.kidInstruction: Kneel tall, open your mouth wide, stick out your tongue, and roar like a lion.

cards.name: Frog Jumps
cards.kidInstruction: Squat down low with your hands on the ground, then spring up and forward like a frog.

cards.name: Eagle Balance
cards.kidInstruction: Stand on one leg, stretch your arms out like wings, and hold steady like an eagle.

cards.name: Elephant Stomps
cards.kidInstruction: Stand tall, lift your knees high, and stomp big heavy feet like an elephant.

cards.name: Lizard Push-Ups
cards.kidInstruction: Get into a low plank and do small push-ups, staying close to the ground like a lizard.
